newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firm buys 40,000 tns U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firm buys 40,000 tns U.S. wheat.

text.p: A Philippine firm bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at $3.70 to $3.90 a bushel, Manila grains traders said on Monday.

Traders said the firm bought 15,000 tonnes of western white wheat at an average $3.70 a bushel FOB U.S. Pacific northwest port. The firm also bought 25,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat at 14 percent protein content at $3.90 a bushel.
"The order was made Friday night through trading firm Marubeni Corp," said one trader.
The wheat is for delivery this month and next month, the trader added.
